senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. Ges. Hebr. Dict.10 s. v.) enclosure, park, pleasure garden.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 1:10">Tosef. Bets. I, 10</cite> <he>החיה שקינתה בפ׳</he> game which nests in a park.
Sot. 10ᵃ (ref. to אשל, Gen. XXI, 33) עשה פ׳ ונטע וכ׳ he made a garden and planted therein &c.; Gen. R. s. 54; a. e.—Trnsf. enclosure in heaven, esoteric philosophy.

<cite ref="Chagigah 14b:8">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>ארבעה נכנסו לפ׳ וכ׳</he> four men entered the enclosure (engaged in esoteric philosophy), one cast a look and died &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:3">Tosef. ib. II, 3</cite>; Y. ib. II, 77ᵇ top.—Pl. <he>פַּרְדֵּסוֹת</he>, <cite ref="Q01579"><he>פַּרְדֵּי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 3:2">Arakh. III, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 14a">14ᵃ</cite>) <he>פ׳ סבסטי</he> the pleasure gardens of Sebaste, v. <cite ref="H00366"><he>חוֹלַת</he></cite>; Tosef. ib. II, 8.

<cite ref="Pesachim 56a">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>פורצין ובפַרְדְּסוֹתֵיהֶן …</he> (some ed. <he>ובפַרְדְּסֵיהֶן</he>) made openings in their gardens and orchards; <cite ref="Menachot 71a">Men. 71ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2">Tosef. Pes. II (III), 21</cite>; a. e.
